source_to_record.source_anchor_editorial_summary: The prior flight judgment continues: a stationary significator remains in its own place until taken
Whether the Thief shall be knowne or not — printed heading
Most planets cadent — historical claim alleged thief becomes known
Sun conjunction, square or opposition to thief significator — allegedly known; p360 line4 original erratum unresolved
Sun sextile thief significator — suspected, not openly known
Whether thief suspected by owner — separate heading
Thief significator square/opposite first lord — suspicion, trine or sextile — no suspicion
Thief significator with Moon — owner suspects someone in his company
Moon square or opposition planet tenth/seventh — suspects one far off, with stated almuten exception
Moon conjunction, square or opposition planet seventh or its almuten — owner suspects that party
Moon aspecting another planet — suspects another, not the supposed thief
Moon joined to or received by evil planet — suspected is supposed thief
Compare first lord and Moon, take stronger; received virtue from evil planets / separating; historical allegation strengthened if second-lord
Angular first lord applying to or separating from cadent planet — truth is said of him, referent unresolved
Moon joined to angular planet, especially tenth — signifies the same unresolved truth consequence
Who did the Deed or Theft — new heading
First lord second, sixth or seventh OR second lord in ASC — claims owner himself
Sun and Moon fourth — father, mother or friend
Sun OR Moon fifth — son or daughter
Sun OR Moon sixth — servant
Sun OR Moon seventh — wife
